title: Q-KG-what-works: give what-works its self-maintained knowledge graph (KGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** knowledge
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --list shows `what-works: live`
**Status:** open

What Works vendors core files already. Add seed/worker/src/knowledge.js to its vendor map, write mappers for its records, run runKg on its clock, serve /api/graph and a live /graph page, then mark it live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json. Unlearn is the reference tenant (ultrastable/unlearn worker/graph.js).

Prediction: kg_nodes for tenant what-works > 0 within 168 h.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --check, with what-works live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json.
